NSUI DUSU Election Loss Sparks Internal Conflict, Questions on Leadership

Following the National Students' Union of India's (NSUI) defeat in the Delhi University Students' Union (DUSU) elections, internal conflict has erupted within the organization, with questions raised about the leadership of Kanhaiya Kumar. While some are blaming Kanhaiya Kumar for the loss, reports suggest the NSUI has repeated its poor electoral performance over the last 12 years. Despite significant issues like the Gen-Z protest at Jantar Mantar and the Satya Niketan hostel accident, internal factionalism and other factors are cited as reasons for the defeat.
